name: IHWA World Wrestling Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top title, defended at every pay-per-view and at least every other month.

name: IHWA World Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Contested only in gimmick matches, defended at every pay-per-view and at least every other month.

name: IHWA Multi-National Championship
epitaph: The promotion's secondary singles title, defended at every pay-per-view and at least once a month.

name: IHWA Bloody Sunday Championship
epitaph: The one singles title defended every Sunday, Bloody Sunday broadcast rather than at every pay-per-view.

name: IHWA World Wrestling Tag Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top tag title, defended at every pay-per-view and at least every other month.

name: IHWA World Hardcore Tag Championship
epitaph: Contested only in gimmick matches, defended at every pay-per-view and at least every other month.

name: IHWA Bloody Sunday Tag Championship
epitaph: The tag title defended every Sunday, Bloody Sunday broadcast rather than at every pay-per-view.
